Before you post

  1. Save each image to your phone or computer.
  2. Open Instagram or Facebook on your side and upload the image.
  3. Paste in the caption and hashtags, and change anything you like.
  4. Read it through to check it suits your clinic, then post or schedule it yourself.
  5. Every caption asks people to comment LENA. When they do, send them a message.
